chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abdullah ibn Maymoun al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) liked the gourd (pumpkin), and he used to pick it up from the platter.

key_terms.يُعْجِبُهُ: He liked it / It was pleasing to him

ai.seo_question: What food did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) particularly like and how did he eat it?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the Prophet’s (PBUH) appreciation for gourd (dubba'), a fruit frequently cited in Shia tradition for its medicinal and spiritual benefits. His act of picking it directly from the common serving platter (sahafa) exemplifies the Sunna of humility and simplicity, rejecting aristocratic affectations in favor of grounded, modest living.
